title: Daredevil
overview: A blind lawyer by day, Matt Murdock uses his heightened senses to fight crime as the vigilante Daredevil on the streets of New York City's Hell's Kitchen.

verification.notes: Confirmed as Marvel Television / Netflix series (Seasons 1-3). Integrated into MCU Sacred Timeline on Disney+ (Jan 2024). Premiered April 10, 2015 during MCU Phase 2 (Season 1), with Seasons 2 and 3 airing during Phase 3.
